events.title: Bucks vs. Thunder
events.addr: 1111 Vel R. Phillips Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53203
events.blurb: The Bucks host the Oklahoma City Thunder on Saturday night, part of a three-game homestand.
events.blurbEs: Los Bucks reciben al Oklahoma City Thunder el sábado por la noche, como parte de una serie de tres partidos en casa.

events.title: Admirals vs. Rockford IceHogs
events.blurb: Milwaukee's AHL hockey team hosts the Rockford IceHogs on Saturday evening.
events.blurbEs: El equipo de hockey de la AHL de Milwaukee recibe a los Rockford IceHogs el sábado por la tarde.

events.title: Dr. Seuss's How the Grinch Stole Christmas!
events.venue: Todd Wehr Theater, Marcus Performing Arts Center
events.blurb: First Stage's stage musical of the Dr. Seuss story, recommended for ages 5 and up. About 95 minutes with an intermission; runs through Dec 27.
events.blurbEs: El musical de First Stage basado en el cuento del Dr. Seuss, recomendado para mayores de 5 años. Dura unos 95 minutos con intermedio; en cartelera hasta el 27 de diciembre.

events.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas in Concert
events.blurb: The Milwaukee Symphony Orchestra plays James Horner's score live while the Jim Carrey film screens. Food and cocktails are served starting 90 minutes before each show.
events.blurbEs: La Milwaukee Symphony Orchestra interpreta en vivo la música de James Horner mientras se proyecta la película con Jim Carrey. Se sirven comidas y cócteles desde 90 minutos antes de cada función.
events.getThere: The Avenue garage (262 W Michigan St) is the MSO's preferred lot, with $20 prepaid parking when bought with tickets; MCTS routes 14, 19, 30 and 57 stop within walking distance.

events.title: Wild Lights at the Milwaukee County Zoo
events.blurb: An evening walk through holiday light displays at the zoo. Last admission is 8:15 p.m.; children 2 and under are free.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo nocturno entre luces navideñas en el zoológico. La última entrada es a las 8:15 p.m.; los niños de 2 años o menos entran gratis.
events.getThere: Parking is included with every Wild Lights ticket.

events.title: Milwaukee Holiday Lights Festival
events.venue: Pere Marquette Park and downtown parks
events.blurb: Themed light displays fill Pere Marquette Park, Cathedral Square, Zeidler Union Square and Red Arrow Park, with chandeliers over 18 blocks of Wisconsin Avenue. Runs through Jan. 1.
events.blurbEs: Hay exhibiciones de luces temáticas en Pere Marquette Park, Cathedral Square, Zeidler Union Square y Red Arrow Park, con candelabros sobre 18 cuadras de Wisconsin Avenue. Hasta el 1 de enero.

events.title: Deer District Holiday Market
events.addr: 1111 Vel R. Phillips Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53203
events.blurb: A free outdoor holiday market with local vendors, photo spots and Santa's Mailbox on the Fiserv Forum plaza. Runs through Dec. 6; check daily hours before you go.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado navideño gratuito al aire libre con vendedores locales, lugares para fotos y el buzón de Santa en la plaza del Fiserv Forum. Hasta el 6 de diciembre; consulta el horario antes de ir.

events.title: A Celebration of Tom Petty featuring The Driveway Thriftdwellers
events.addr: 1040 Vel R. Phillips Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53203
events.blurb: Local band The Driveway Thriftdwellers lead a Tom Petty tribute night with guests Joseph Huber, Brett Newski, Laura Bomber and Derek Pritzl.
events.blurbEs: La banda local The Driveway Thriftdwellers encabeza una noche de homenaje a Tom Petty con los invitados Joseph Huber, Brett Newski, Laura Bomber y Derek Pritzl.
